Your need for a secure, high-performance client portal aligns with my recent work on inventory and order-tracking systems. For background processing, I have deployed Celery workers to handle asynchronous tasks such as report generation and email dispatching, ensuring the main application remains responsive [E3][E4]. Security is handled through OAuth integration, including token refresh and scope management, which I implemented for a logistics inventory tracker to secure third-party sign-ins [E5][E6]. My portfolio includes fintech, energy, retail, and logistics sectors [E1][E2][E3][E6]. I can apply these proven patterns to your manufacturing context to build a reliable portal.
